basics.type: Private college group set up in 2002 by the Kartar Educational & Cultural Society; BFIT Technical Campus is approved by AICTE
basics.ugc: Courses affiliated to HNB Garhwal (Central) University; BFIT Technical Campus affiliated to Uttarakhand Technical University
basics.other: B.Tech (Civil, Mechanical, Electrical, ECE, CSE), BBA, BCA, B.Com, B.Sc IT, hotel management, agriculture (B.Sc Horticulture, Forestry) and life sciences

admission: Class 12 percentage, AIBFEE (BFIT's entrance exam) or group discussion and interview
BBA, BCA, B.Com, B.Sc IT, BHM
Selection committee on merit and entrance

scholarships.text: Scholarships for meritorious and deserving students, decided by the Kartar Educational & Cultural Society.

hostel.text: On-campus residences; apply for a room online.

fees.text: BFIT publishes a downloadable fee structure for each course. Ask us for the current fee for your course.
